name: chat-assistant
description: A conversational model answering in a chat interface with no tools, code execution, memory, delegation, or actuation. It processes instructions and can defer a request to the human it is talking to. Use it with `caap assess prompt` to assess any LLM through a pasted prompt.
notes: Applicable scope covers the GH and HT domains (37 patterns). The single prompt is about 50 KB; pass --chunk-size to split it for smaller context windows.
